takeaways: The best unused MFPAA material is raw motion b-roll. Rigs driving toward camera and follow-car road shots (Cam B 36/44, iPhone 19/21 with lights flashing), the top-down drone (Mike's Footage 1) and the EMS patch-wall pan would make the hero loop feel more like an emergency service than the current cut from the 60 s brand spot does. For any hero cut from the Feb spot, use the textless '60 Sec (1 minute base)' master instead of the final, which has lower-thirds and stat text baked in. Jason Wolfe's donor testimonial is the only finished capital-campaign ad not on the site; it belongs on work/mfpaa and in anatomy-of-a-47k-nonprofit-campaign next to the Chief and Patient spots, along with the behind-the-scenes photo of the interview setup (Mike's Footage 5), which also proves production on content-development. For the MFPAA cover, the agency-shot rig outside the station (2.4.26 RAW 12) or the 9.26.25 rig still (31) are safe picks. The client-supplied HDR fleet lineup is stronger but is not Stoop work. Two on-site subscription ads show typos ('DONT' in 7|60, 'THATS' in It's Your Job) and should be fixed or demoted.
